description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `5a72b85`: Roadmap: B9 (Board.Reports) and B10 (Board.Timeline) done
- DevHub-Plugins `d1d65b4`: B9 follow-up and B10: Board.Timeline (requires Board) — a start date on issues (kept before the due date; in the issue view), the roadmap in Timeline.Core (epics and optionally their issues from start to due, dates worked out from the issues or a default when not set, progress by points, late, blockers and conflicts), releases (progress, late) with Markdown release notes and a Release operation that moves unfinished issues on (4 tests); Timeline page (drawn bars and date scale, today's line, tooltips, click to edit in the issue panel) and Releases page (versions, issues, notes, Save Release Notes, Release, New Version). Checked in a running DevHub
